refreshNotes:
Second model year of the all-electric i5 sedan after MY2024 launch. Three trims: eDrive40, xDrive40, M60 xDrive. Carries over from MY2024 with minor option-package adjustments. EPA-rated range up to 295 mi (eDrive40), 269 mi (xDrive40), 256 mi (M60).

- https://www.bmwbellevue.com/research/2025-bmw-i5-trim-levels.htm
